observations: Both begin on black, introduce a centered blue-white point, then show a horizontal line and progressively assembled desktop terminal.
Desktop panel relationships are preserved: watchlist left, chart upper center, positions/payoff below and option chain right.
Chart price badges match the prominent sampled values at 12–13 seconds; option-chain pills match at 18–20 seconds.
Both include candle magnification, option-chain and positions inspection, desktop retreat, a spatial interlude and landscape-phone reveal.
The mobile order ticket, Buy emphasis and confirmation appear at corresponding sampled phases around 39–41 seconds.
The closing card preserves Sahi, “Single screen trading on” and “Your Money. Your Move.” with the phone above and a final fade.
remaining_differences: At 2–3 seconds, ORIGINAL has a visible circular ring around the central glow. GPT retains a smaller point without the corresponding visible ring.

ORIGINAL already shows the chart across its upper-center panel. GPT exposes mainly the peak and nearby candles within a smaller central region, leaving much of the chart area empty. The sampled assembly state differs.

Across the desktop views, GPT replaces ORIGINAL's irregular, multi-swing candle series with a sharper isolated summit and a comparatively smooth, extended descent. Peak shape, intermediate rebounds, trough geometry and the lavender curve differ substantially.

The chart close-up is framed too broadly in GPT: more candles and a wider trough/recovery sequence remain visible. ORIGINAL crops more tightly around the latest recovery and right price axis, with a blue-white highlight on the newest candle that GPT lacks at 12–13 seconds.

At 15–16 seconds, ORIGINAL resolves into fine RGB subpixels, horizontal divisions, dark lattice and luminous screen texture. GPT shows coarse mint/pink bars with conspicuous black grid lines, little comparable RGB separation and much cleaner edges. Its oversized node/path arrangement also occupies different positions relative to the candle boundary.

GPT's returning candle view remains wider: additional candles and more of the lower lavender curve are visible. ORIGINAL emphasizes the tall mint/pink pair more tightly and gives the nearby white nodes a stronger soft glow.

At 18–20 seconds, GPT simplifies the option-chain close-up into three principal numerical columns. ORIGINAL also shows substantial outer quantity/metric columns, including values such as “119.9L” and “−0.40”. Row scale and vertical placement differ despite matching current-price pill text.

The sampled positions states diverge: ORIGINAL's row quotes and P&L figures change between 22 and 23 seconds, while GPT retains the same displayed rows. Matching the total “+₹1,547” does not reproduce those underlying updates.

The full-resolution pair shows different camera framing: ORIGINAL clips the upper chart heavily and places the positions panel higher; GPT retains the chart's full summit and places positions lower. Readable data also differs: ORIGINAL shows Total P&L “+₹1,541”, first-row LTP “86.35” and second-row LTP “32.10”; GPT shows “+₹1,544”, “86.25” and “32.05”.

Across 28–35 seconds, GPT's spatial interlude is much emptier and dimmer. ORIGINAL contains a more developed constellation network, numerous cross-shaped glints, visible connecting segments, labeled haloed nodes and stronger blue/purple haze. GPT chiefly presents two glowing points among faint pinpricks, losing much of this scene's visual mechanism.

The phone's internal proportions differ: GPT allocates more screen width to the chart and compresses the option chain. Its chart also has a smoother descending profile and a differently positioned early spike, whereas ORIGINAL contains more irregular candle clusters and rebounds.

GPT's buy ticket is smaller and less opaque, allowing option-chain content to remain conspicuous behind its text. ORIGINAL presents a more solid dark card with a larger, brighter Buy-button region. The overlay's visual separation and hierarchy are weaker in GPT.
After confirmation, ORIGINAL retains a clearly outlined option cell in the right table at 41–42 seconds. GPT shows the confirmation toast but lacks that corresponding outlined-cell feedback.
The full-resolution final pair shows GPT further faded than ORIGINAL: the device rim, screen and tagline are less visible at the same requested timestamp.
